name: EPIC 201583607
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 6.2 solar radii and 1.11 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201583607 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.225927 (16th-84th percentiles 6.003401-6.460278), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201583607 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.108688 (16th-84th percentiles 1.011655-1.216468), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201583607: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4861.439 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201583607 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3368.554688 (16th-84th percentiles 3269.179688-3472.148438), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.08 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,369 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.11 solar masses and 6.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,861 K at its surface.
